crop.definition: SHA256(namespace UTF8 plus NUL; tensors in ascending key order; for each tensor: uint64 big-endian metadata-byte length, compact sorted UTF8 JSON {name,dtype,shape,byte_order:little}, uint64 big-endian data-byte length, detached dense contiguous CPU tensor bytes in C order and little endian). Includes parameters and persistent buffers; excludes checkpoint metadata and serialization.
